title: Scoreboard Issue Logic
constraints: `pending[r]` = a result for register r is still in flight. Register 0 is never pending and never causes a hazard.
Each rising edge first applies the writeback: `wb_valid` clears `pending[wb_rd]`. The cleared bit counts immediately (write-back bypass).

Then the instruction may issue if `issue_valid`, and none of rs1 (RAW), rs2 (RAW) or rd (WAW) is pending after the writeback. If it issues: `pending[rd] <= 1` (unless rd = 0) and `issued = 1`. Otherwise `issued = 0`.
Outputs are registered. Synchronous reset clears everything. Must be synthesizable.
hints: Compute `after_wb = pending & ~wb_mask` first, and use it both for the hazard check and as the base of the new state.
A register-0 mask (`& 8'hFE`) avoids special cases.
WAW matters: issuing a second writer to r5 while r5 is pending could let the older result overwrite the newer one.
